chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang outwits the Zuowandao, learns to control his hallucinations, and faces an impossible choice in the shocking Volume 2 finale.
og_title: Li Huowang Finally Masters His Own Madness – And It Changes Everything
og_description: Three layers of deception lead to Li Huowang's greatest breakthrough yet, but is the hospital room a cure or another hallucination?
twitter_title: Li Huowang just turned the Zuowandao's own game against them. Vol 2 ends with a promise that will break your heart.

lore_anchors.definition: The classic xianxia term for seeking immortality through authentic cultivation; in this novel, it is directly opposed by the Zuowandao's "Cultivate the False."
A Zuowandao doctrine where belief in a lie can make it real; the opposite of traditional cultivation.
Primordial cosmic energy present in all beings before birth; in the Dao-Twisted World, a Heart-Element's leakage of this pneuma causes reality-altering hallucinations.
A concentrated visual energy gathered from the eyes in internal alchemy; used here to locate and seal the innate pneuma.
A rare human constitution that leaks innate pneuma uncontrollably, blurring the line between reality and hallucination.
A Chinese idiom describing a chain of unseen predators; here, it literally describes Li Huowang watching North Wind watch her own test subject.
A real-world psychiatric treatment involving controlled seizures; in the novel, it represents the modern world's attempt to "cure" Li Huowang's condition.
